The '''Kessel Massacre''' was an event that took place in the [[Spice mines of Kessel/Legends|Spice Mines]] of [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] at some point before the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]].<ref name="CSWE" />

The event began when [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] protested their [[Miner/Legends|working]] conditions in the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Mining/Legends|mines]] of Kessel. The [[Chistori]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cydon Prax]] was called in to quell the uprising. Prax, a tenacious warrior who fought without compassion, brutally ended the protests with the [[Death/Legends|slaughter]] of six thousand slaves.<ref name="CSWE" />

Eventually, Prax became [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] right-hand enforcer immediately after the death of [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] at the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="CSWE" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC" /> the ruthless [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] was remembered and feared throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] as the [[Gender/Legends|man]] responsible for the Kessel Massacre.<ref name="CSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kessel Massacre was first mentioned in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', a [[2008]] reference book written by [[Stephen J. Sansweet]] and [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="CSWE" />
